brief: A read-only AI code review agent for developers and maintainers. The identity should feel precise, observant and restrained.
criteria: Distinct paired-source geometry; consistent monochrome rendering; a separate 16px cut; no promise of defect-free code.

concepts.name: Source Pair / 双侧对照
concepts.idea: Two source boundaries focus on one fact.
rationale: Paired boundaries echo Base / Head comparison.
The central diamond gives the review a clear evidence focus.
Open geometry keeps the identity light and readable.

recommendation: Use the horizontal lockup for headers, the symbol for compact spaces, and the hinted small cut below 32px.
next_steps: Application integration remains a separate change.
Trademark clearance and print proofing have not been performed.
